evidence_excerpt: Fix a regression on ROCm where the init-time `e_score_correction_bias` dtype cast became a no-op after #39141 removed the `set_out_dtype()` call, re-introducing a per-layer elementwise kernel on every forward pass.

Add env flags to disable dynamic MXFP4 quant and enable AITER tuned GEMMs for Attention Projection Layers — route unquantized attention GEMMs through AITER's newer FlyDSL-based tuned GEMM implementations, instead of the default skinny-reduce or hipBLASLt paths.
Kimi-K2.5 multimodal inference (images/video) is completely broken because KimiK25Config.media_placeholder_token_id (163605) disagrees with the tokenizer's actual mapping for <|media_pad|> (163602).
Install libcublas-dev in Dockerfile for FlashInfer CuTe DSL JIT — change `libcublas-${CUDA_VERSION_DASH}` to `libcublas-dev-${CUDA_VERSION_DASH}`.
Fix FlashInferNVLinkOneSidedManager and TwoSidedManager so the MNNVL workspace is sized to the EP group instead of the DP group.
Treat <tool_call> as implicit reasoning end in Qwen3 parser — the fix treats <tool_call> as an implicit end-of-reasoning marker in both streaming and non-streaming paths.
fix output Nan/Inf in marlin if dtype=float16 — we dynamically scale the input before GEMM to prevent data overflow.
Auto-disable DeepGemm for Qwen3.5 on Blackwell. Adds a model-type exclusion list checked during config finalization on SM100+. When triggered, use_deep_gemm is set to False with a one-time warning.
FP8 FlashInfer Attn for ViT — adds optional FP8 quantization for ViT encoder attention via the FlashInfer cuDNN backend.
Current replica selection in the EPLB fused-MoE router distributes tokens unevenly across replicas of the same logical expert. Switching to a different hashing implementation fixes this.
Fix workspace resize leaking reserved GPU memory — even though the previous buffer is deleted before the new one is allocated, there is no guarantee that the previous buffer is actually reclaimed.
fix Qwen3 MoE call gate twice — Qwen3 MoE model will call gate gemm twice; this PR follows deepseek_v2.py and uses is_internal_router.
Enable FP8 on NVIDIA Thor — small change allows FP8 models to be run on NVIDIA Thor (SM110); kernel previously only supported sm100f.

TurboQuant adds online KV cache compression to vLLM's v1 attention backend using PolarQuant for keys and uniform quantization for values. All quantization happens at store time via fused Triton kernels.

Fix AttributeError in Qwen3.5 GDN layers with quantized models — MergedColumnParallelLinear does not expose a .weight attribute when using quantization methods, causing AttributeError during the forward pass.
Replace the concatenate-sentinel-then-argmax approach with a simple sum of valid tokens — eliminates unnecessary memory allocation and is more readable.
Align is_tma_supported in vLLM's GDN kernels with upstream FLA behavior: TMA is now disabled by default and requires FLA_USE_TMA=1 to enable — env-var-gated routing fix.
Do not shard shared experts weights when sequence parallel is enabled to fix precision issue for Qwen3.5/Qwen3-Next with EP.
fix input_ids and expert_map args for quark w4a8 gptoss — #40860 added input_ids arg to QuarkOCP_MX_MoEMethod.apply_monolithic, but not to the OSS variant.
Add basic mrcr eval to tests/evals/ — adds a smoke test for long-context behavior using OpenAI's public openai/mrcr dataset.
Fix OOM by setting PyTorch max_split_size_mb during model loading — upgrade from PyTorch 2.9 to 2.10 increased memory fragmentation during startup, leading to OOMs for GPT-OSS 120B TP2 on 2xH100.
Support limiting thinking tokens and forcing thinking end tokens via logit processors — feature designed to prevent uncontrolled reasoning length.
Enable FlashInfer top-k/top-p sampler by default — FlashInfer top-k/top-p has better performance compared to Triton's implementation; flips backend selection.
Several quantization methods were failing on ROCm because they weren't registered in the platform's supported_quantization list, even though the underlying kernels already support them.
Bulk merge of 5 Silo config-only PRs for v0.1.13 deadline (vLLM 0.21 freeze 2026-05-08). Pure CSV tuning configs — no code changes.
Fix splitk tmp_out undersized buffer avoid double-zeroing — the tmp_out buffer was allocated as (token_num, topk, w1.shape[1]) which is undersized when splitK > 1.
Add FlyDSL a4w4 MoE kernel implementation with preshuffle pipeline optimization; add layernorm kernel, layout utilities, and common kernel helpers for FlyDSL.
SGLang crashes when serving Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4 (384 experts) for long sequence lengths — RuntimeError: num_experts must be a power of 2, but got 384. Update topk.py to support non-power-of-2 experts.
Create script to benchmark attention kernels with shapes of LLM models — comprehensive benchmarking routine, capable of measuring the Triton attention kernels performance.
Add new GEMM configuration files for DSKR1 — three new JSON configuration files for GEMM operations (gfx942-GEMM-A8W8_BLOCKSCALE-N=*).
dsv3 blockscale gemm config in mi300 — large CSV-only updates to a8w8_blockscale_tuned_gemm_ds_v3.csv and untuned counterpart.
Re-tuned BF16 GEMM configs for GPT-OSS, DSV3, Kimi-K2 with FlyDSL competing alongside ASM/hipBLASLt/Triton; added new BF16 GEMM tuned configs for Llama 70B, Llama 405B, Qwen 32B.
rm cu=80 configs and update dsv3 bpreshuffle configs — when same shape exists for cu=80 and cu=256 the later one covers the first one, which causes finding wrong kernel in mi355.
Add tuned GEMM/MoE configs for DeepSeek-R1-0528-MXFP4 on MI355X (cu_num=256): a8w8_bpreshuffle 45 shapes, a4w4_blockscale 30 shapes, fp4 FusedMoE 15 shapes.
Gemm & moe tunning for DeepSeek-R1 in InferenceX FP4 case — for dsv3 EP8 fp4 decode.
Add configurable blockPerCu (1-4) to CKTile GEMM kernels (blockscale, bpreshuffle, MOE) and add CKTile to MOE tuner — extends both kernel instances and the tuning search space.
CI: add top-priority models to vLLM benchmark — replace the generic vLLM benchmark matrix with explicit top-priority lanes for gpt-oss-120b, DeepSeek-R1-0528, and Kimi-K2.5.
Update kimik2 FP4 tuned fMoE config — Kimik2-Thinking-MXFP4 e2e runs are not picking performant MOE1 kernels; re-tuned the 2-stage fused MoE GEMM kernel selection.
Retune Kimi configs: Add the third expert group with inter_dim=385, topk=9 to provide full MoE configuration coverage for the Kimik2 model.
Add A4W4 blockscale GEMM tuned configs for Kimi-K2.5 and add fused_moe tuned configs for Kimi-K2.5 (385 experts, topk=9, inter_dim=512, fp4 per_1x32, token=1~32768).

Special path for moe ptpc fp8, batch 1~32 — further optimize Qwen3.5 397B FP8 PTPC MOE in decoding phase for batch size 1-32 with FP8 weight decompression. Disabled by default, opt-in via AITER_MOE_SMALL_BATCH=1.
Introduce asm fmoe kernels that do not require bf16->fp8 quantization — for qwen3-next model in TP4 mode there is no assembly kernel that can match h_dim=128. This PR is introducing one.

Annotate moe_sorting_dispatch_policy as int for fused_moe — bool annotation incorrect: PyTorch schema enforcement casts any value to bool, so dispatch_policy=2 becomes True (1), silently losing the intended policy.
Introduce 16x128 fused moe kernel with weights prefetch — about 10% faster than CK kernel for qwen3-next shapes for tokens 1,2,4.
The 1-stage fused allreduce+RMSNorm kernel produces numerically different residual outputs compared to the unfused path; compounds across transformer layers causing −2.6pp on GSM8K.
fix use after free issue in moe_sorting_fwd — declare torch::Tensor ws outside curly braces to make the lifecycle valid.
16x256 kernel is an extension of 16x128 which can be better with certain inputs when 16x128 will require multiple rounds of scheduling.
The CKTile blockscale GEMM host wrapper hardcoded leading-dimension strides assuming fully contiguous row-major layout; in vLLM on ROCm this produced narrowed views with non-default strides.
Add 32x128 and 64x128 asm kernels to support qwen3-next TP4 — 2 more assembly kernels added to process 32 and 64 tokens per thread group respectively when h_dim is restricted to 128.
fix num_stages in test_ff_a16w16_fused.py to account for irregular shapes — fix test failures on gfx950 when TRITON_HIP_USE_ASYNC_COPY=1 is enabled.
The 2-stage fused_allreduce_rmsnorm path in custom_all_reduce.cuh can return wrong results — fix cross-device memory ordering.
Add StreamLLM sink token support for batch_prefill pipeline — depends on CK-side change that promotes kHasSink_ to a real template parameter, enabling _sink/_nsink kernel variant codegen.
Fix some benchmark scripts so that they generate the output CSVs — bug affects bench_moe_gemm_a4w4.py, a8w4, a8w8, a8w8_blockscale, int8_smoothquant.
Generalize the GDN per-request state decoupling into a complete model-agnostic KV cache abstraction owned by the AttentionMetadataBuilder hierarchy.
feat: PD disaggregation — new sequence status WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS, deferred block deallocation, connector metadata per batch.
DeepSeek v3.2: add sparse prefill mla and fix indexer rope — touches attention_mla.py, aiter_mla.py, models/deepseek_v2.py.
Update GLM-5.md to refer to atom-dev docker container — updating container from rocm/atom:latest to rocm/atom-dev:latest.
TP4 benchmark results for DeepSeek-R1-0528 (FP8 and MXFP4) were not visible in the benchmark dashboard because they shared the same derived model name as their TP8 counterparts.
docs: add Hermes Agent setup guide — step-by-step guide for using Hermes Agent with ATOM as the local inference backend.
Refactors the monolithic openai_server.py into focused modules and adds tool calling, reasoning content separation, and optional request logging.
upgrade vLLM to 0.19.0 commit 2a6994 — bumps plugin compat against new vLLM commit.

Both Kimi-K2-Thinking-MXFP4 and Kimi-K2.5-MXFP4 now support fp4 quantization of shared experts, thus shared experts can be fused with routed experts and don't need ATOM_DUAL_STREAM_MOE_TOKEN_THRESHOLD=0 anymore.
Update the recipe for Kimi-K2 and Kimi-K2.5 — touches recipes/atom_vllm/Kimi-K2-Thinking.md and Kimi-K2.5.md.
Fix Qwen3.5 RoPE validation ignore keys type — affected configs set ignore_keys_at_rope_validation as a list, but newer transformers code treats this field as a set.
Add support for Qwen3.5 and Qwen3-Next to ATOM-plugined SGLang — adds new model wrappers under atom/plugin/sglang/models/qwen3_5.py and attention backends.
Fix qwen3.5 fp8 functionality and accuracy issue — fix both fp8 and bf16 qwen3.5 moe model.
Review: improve blog-atom-vllm-plugin.md clarity, completeness, and references — structural fixes and content improvements.
Phase 2: replace dict-style quant_config access with LayerQuantConfig — converts all other models to use the structured quantization config instead of a dict.
This PR adds Qwen3.5 model support to ATOM, including both dense and MoE variants — leverages ATOM's vLLM plugin mode and ATOM's optimized kernels for linear attention (GatedDeltaNet) layers.
optimize qwen3 next inplace copy — touches layernorm.py, triton_gemma_rmsnorm.py, qwen3_5.py, qwen3_next.py.
refine the atom-vllm benchmark and add ATOM_USE_FLYDSL_GDR=1 for qwen3 next model — env-var that gates routing to FlyDSL GDR backend.
DualRMSNorm: Fused Q/K RMSNorm Triton kernel wrapper; QKVGParallelLinear: Deinterleaves HF checkpoint's interleaved Q+Gate weights — single-launch fused Triton kernel for qwen3_next.
Fix false-positive regression alerts when throughput improved; fix parseBenchName regex to handle multi-word model names; add _tp field for correct TP column display.
This PR refactors and optimizes attention metadata. It can bring a 1% to 2% performance improvement on gpt-oss-120b in low concurrency.
Support TBO in ATOM — enable TBO with dp attn + mori (--enable-dp-attention --enable-expert-parallel --enable-tbo).
Add amd/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-MXFP4-Preview to the ATOM nightly benchmark pipeline — touches .github/benchmark/models.json and atom-benchmark.yaml.
remove rmsnorm allreduce fusion in gpt-oss — added contiguous to tensor_model_parallel_fused_allreduce_rmsnorm ops because it does not support non-contiguous input.
fix tp8 accuracy for gpt-oss — add contiguous before all reduce; currently remove rms + allreduce fused op because aiter ops not supported.
load quark gpt_oss 120b wmxfp4 afp8 — adds loader support for amd/gpt_oss_120b_w_mxfp4_a_fp8.
